answer.explanation: To rebalance the portfolio to 60% STOCK, 30% BOND, and 10% CASH while respecting the AAPL no-sell restriction and 20% individual stock cap, sell 25 shares of MSFT ($10,000) and buy 125 shares of BND ($10,000). This brings total stock allocation from 70% down to 60% and bond allocation from 20% up to 30%, keeping cash at 10%.
